concept: EC2 purchasing: Reserved Instances / Savings Plans for steady workloads
tests: Choosing a purchasing model for steady, predictable compute over 3 years.
expected: Standard Reserved Instances for the baseline and Compute Savings Plans — deep discounts for a term commitment. Triggers: "steady, predictable usage", "next three years", "specific instance family in one Region".
why_not: On-Demand for the whole baseline — no commitment discount; Spot for an always-on production DB — interruptions; on-demand Dedicated Hosts — the most expensive.
